content: sony/sonyflake: 39 bits time in 10ms units, 8 bits sequence, 16 bits machine id; 174-year lifetime, 2^16 machines, only 2^8 IDs per 10ms per instance. StartTime must be before current time. MachineID defaults to lower 16 bits of private IP; CheckMachineID hook validates uniqueness, instance refused if check fails. Demonstrates: machine-id-derivation-from-IP pattern fails on Kubernetes overlay networks where pod IPs collide across clusters/namespaces, and sequence exhaustion errors must be surfaced.
